name: tidyinbox
description: Clean promotional email in Gmail or Outlook. Install TidyInbox, then invoke it with @tidyinbox in ChatGPT Desktop.

interface.longDescription: Install TidyInbox from the tidyinbox-marketplace in ChatGPT Desktop, connect Gmail or Outlook, then start a new chat and type @tidyinbox. Ask it to clean your inbox or review promotions. It checks recipients, protects important mail, uses supported unsubscribe requests, and moves old promotions to recoverable Deleted Items or Trash.
defaultPrompt: @tidyinbox review my Gmail promotions and unsubscribe from unwanted senders
